name: simplex
description: Each Claude Code session gets its own SimpleX group. There you prompt the session, approve its actions and tool use, and read its answers.

main_group.title: Main group
main_group.description: Name of the SimpleX group where you join the groups of your sessions. On a machine with SIMPLEX_MCP_MACHINE set, " - " and its value follow.

approve.title: Approval
approve.description: requests: you approve connections and messages in the SimpleX app. host: Claude Code asks you instead, after an admin or owner approves this in the session's group.

expire_hours.title: Expiry in hours
expire_hours.description: Actions you have not approved expire after this many hours.
